title: Link button in a Slack message shows a warning icon after the user clicks it
symptoms: Small warning triangle next to a URL button after click
Link opens fine but Slack desktop marks the button as failed
No error in the app logs because no handler exists
cause: A button with a url still sends a block_actions payload to the app, and Slack expects a 200 within three seconds. With no listener, the request fails and the client shows the warning. Slack staff confirmed this is intended.
fix: Register a listener for the button's action_id that only acknowledges.
affected: Slack desktop and web clients, Block Kit buttons with url, all versions as of 2026-10
